other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a student
The beneficiary must be receiving any scholarship from the Government of India
The beneficiary must return the books after completing the course

The beneficiary must be enrolled in one of the specified professional courses (Medical, Engineering, Law, MBA, Veterinary, Agriculture, Polytechnic, Chartered Accountants, Cost Accountants, Postgraduate Technical Courses, etc.)
benefits_summary: Free textbooks are provided to eligible students, with each book shared between two students at no cost and required to be returned after course completion.
documents_required: Application form collected from the principal of the educational institution
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
